import os, requests
api_key = os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY', '')

    keyfile = os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE', '')
    if keyfile:
        api_key = open(keyfile).read().strip()

base = 'https://usegalaxy.org'
headers = {'x-api-key': api_key}

    count = int(parts[1])

    density = count / length
    results.append((chrom, count, length, density))

for chrom, count, length, density in results:

print(f'  {results[0][1]} CpG sites / {results[0][2]} bp = {results[0][3]*1e6:.4f} CpG sites per Mb')
